principle: Features are enabled from observed source capabilities, not from race-name assumptions. Missing splits or geometry never get synthesized.

results_database.description: Searchable finish-result database for the selected race/year.

finish_statistics.description: Finish distributions, placement statistics and participation summaries.

runner_profile.description: Individual/team result profile with source-backed detail fields.

split_analysis.description: Checkpoint and segment analysis using actual published split observations.

runner_replay.description: Interpolated replay between real timing observations on a verified route.

map_duel.description: Head-to-head map comparison driven by real timing observations and route interpolation.

course_difficulty_vs_pacing.description: Relates route characteristics to observed segment pacing.

course_version_records.description: Records and cross-year performance comparisons restricted to verified comparable course versions.

cross_year_participation.description: Participation, gender, age and repeat-runner trends where source fields support them.
